name: Episode Browser
description: The URLQuery report catalog grouped into episodes, the bursts of one data source's reports less than two hours apart, as a time range over every episode with lanes of the episodes in it and a sortable list with each one's span, size and mix of direct requests, proxies and submitted programs, colored by confidence, class, disposition, source basis, cohort or a label with thimble's Color by; the episodes in view summed up on demand, any episode opened under its row with its reports in time order and any report in full under its row with its source row, provenance and decisions.

records.name: report
records.one: one row of all-reports.csv, with its report-sources.csv row joined by report_id

fields.name: t
fields.how: read as seconds since 1970 in UTC

fields.name: gap
fields.from: report_date_utc of the report and of the one before it in its episode

fields.name: why_short
fields.how: each stock sentence cut to a few words and the disclaimer on imported tags dropped

fields.name: cohort
fields.how: whether it names the externally selected research-activity cohort

fields.name: group
fields.how: joined by report_id, a report with no source row grouped as Needs review or Background control

fields.name: value
fields.how: the report's confidence, broad_class, disposition, source_basis or cohort, or a label's value on its catalog row or source row

records.name: episode
records.one: the reports of one data source whose consecutive times are less than two hours apart

fields.name: start
fields.how: the first report's time, a gap of two hours or more starting the next episode

fields.name: duration
fields.how: time from the first report to the last

fields.name: cohort
fields.how: share whose why_included names the externally selected research-activity cohort

fields.name: rate
fields.how: reports in each of 24 equal slices of its span

fields.name: peak_minute
fields.how: most reports in one clock minute in UTC

fields.name: peak_hour
fields.how: most reports in one clock hour in UTC

fields.name: cv
fields.how: the episode's reports the label filter keeps, per value of the choice

accepts.means: row <n> of all-reports.csv or report-sources.csv, the report it names opened in its episode, or of selection-provenance.csv, the report it is about
the report on line <n> of a CSV file, or the decision whose lines hold line <n> of a decisions file, opened in its episode
decision <k> of supplement-classifications.json or classification-overrides.json, its report opened in its episode

units.means: one episode, named by its data source in lower case with dashes and its first report's UTC time, such as unctad/2026-05-17T00:10:01Z, opened with its reports
every episode of one data source, such as unctad or needs-review, the view narrowed to it
